headline: Rangers Ruin The Sweep At Fenway As Connelly Early Gets Rocked Early
morning_brew: The dream of a sweep at Fenway went up in smoke on Sunday, and it didn't take long to happen. Connelly Early served up a home run to Wyatt Langford on his very first pitch of the game, and things just went downhill from there. Early got absolutely hammered for eleven hits and six earned runs before getting pulled in the fifth. I watched Kyle Higashioka launch that three-run homer in the second and felt my chest tighten up. We fought back a bit with some late runs, but you can't spot a team like Texas a big lead and expect to walk away happy.

Willson Contreras did everything he could to keep us in this one, going three for four with two solo shots. The guy has been an absolute beast, but he can't carry this entire lineup when Ceddanne Rafaela is putting up an oh for four night. My neighbor Rick was screaming at the television about the strike zone, claiming the umpires had it out for us from the jump. Honestly, after watching some of those low calls, I'm almost ready to help him write his weekly letter to the league commissioner. We ended up with nine hits but couldn't string them together when we needed that one big hit to tie it up.

Down in Foxborough, the wait continues for Gabe Jacas to sign his rookie contract and get his rear end into minicamp. We need everyone on the field if we're going to build on last year's Super Bowl appearance, so the front office has to get this sorted out. Meanwhile, the Celtics are sitting with the third-best odds for next year's title, which is nice, but I'm still too sour about the Philadelphia collapse to care about next winter's betting lines.

trend_watch.trend: Early lasted only four and two-thirds innings after getting battered for eleven hits.
trend_watch.dans_take: You can't give up a home run on your very first pitch of the afternoon and expect to survive.

trend_watch.trend: Contreras smashed two home runs and went three for four at the plate.
trend_watch.dans_take: This guy is trying to carry the offense on his back, but he needs some help.

trend_watch.trend: Watson threw two scoreless frames of relief with one strikeout.
trend_watch.dans_take: Nice to see the bullpen hold the line after the starter put us in a massive hole.
